data.fund_type: An open ended ultra-short term debt scheme investing in instruments such that the Macaulay Duration of the portfolio is between 3 months to 6 months
data.investment_objective: The investment objective is to provide investors with an opportunity to generate regular income with high degree of liquidity through investments in a portfolio comprising predominantly of debt and money market instruments
data.asset_allocation: Debt instruments (including Central and State Government(s) securities, Debt derivatives) and Money Market instruments 0%-100% Low to Medium
data.benchmark: NIFTY Ultra Short Duration Debt Index
